articles.title: Quote of the day by Tiger Woods, 'If you are given a chance to be a role model, I think you should always take it because you can influence a person's life in a positive light, and that's what I want to do. That's what it's all about' teaches timeless powerful lesson on how to become idol, achieve success in career, work, relationship, love, friendship
articles.description: Quote of the day by Tiger Woods is a powerful reminder that influence carries an opportunity to make someone elses life better. Becoming a role model is not about appearing flawless or receiving constant praise. It is about using personal experiences, abilities, and visibility to encourage positive choices in others. Whether through professional achievement, family relationships, mentorship, education, sport, or everyday kindness, people can create meaningful influence through the examples they set.

articles.title: ICICI Bank, Federal Bank among top bank picks by Axis Direct after Q1 earnings season
articles.description: Banks, including small finance banks, fared better across parameters in a seasonally weak Q1, with the key highlight of the quarter being robust credit growth momentum across the board and strong asset quality performance. Credit growth accelerated to ~18% YoY, largely driven by Corporate, SME, and select Retail Segments, with banks seeing a revival in unsecured segment growth as asset quality concerns normalised. The Small/Mid-size banks outperformed their larger peers with growth robust at 27% and 20% YoY respectively, closely followed by PSBs (+18% YoY) and larger private (pvt.) banks (+17% YoY), as per the coverage by Axis Direct.
